reason: ContextGate is a Cordis/DSH plugin that manages oversized LLM conversation history by selecting relevant messages and folding older context into summaries, with token estimation, gatekeeper decisions, fallback rules, and runtime status reporting.

summaries.zh: ContextGate 是一个用于 DSH/Cordis 的上下文管理插件，可在对话历史超出阈值时筛选相关消息并将其余历史折叠为摘要。
summaries.en: ContextGate is a DSH/Cordis context-management plugin that selects relevant conversation history and folds excess messages into a summary when token usage exceeds a threshold.

capabilities: Folds oversized conversation history into summaries
Invokes a gatekeeper LLM to assess message relevance
May request user confirmation through the UI
